final: WITH media_averages AS (SELECT m.Name AS media_type, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_averages FROM media_averages) SELECT ma.media_type, ma.avg_ratio, ma.avg_ratio - oa.avg_of_averages AS difference FROM media_averages AS ma CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa WHERE oa.avg_of_averages IS NOT NULL AND ma.avg_ratio > oa.avg_of_averages
